notes.claim: With brackets in an equation, noticing the structure helps decide the most efficient method, so there is more than one way to start.
A solution can be checked by substituting the value into the equation.
An equation with fractions can be cleared by multiplying both sides by the least common denominator of all the fractions in it.

sources.title: Ch. 1 Solve Linear Equations: Mini-Lesson Review - Algebra 1 | OpenStax
sources.quote: You can check the solution by substituting the value into the equation.

sources.title: 2.2 Solving linear equations (NCETM mastery PD)
sources.quote: By considering a range of linear equations involving brackets, students should explore the importance of noticing the structure of an equation in order to decide on the most efficient method for solving it.

sources.title: 2.5 Solve Equations with Fractions or Decimals - Elementary Algebra 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: We will apply the Multiplication Property of Equality and multiply both sides of an equation by the least common denominator of all the fractions in the equation.
